items.title: Artie Shaw — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I’ll tell you who else I worked with every once in a while: Paul Specht would get a band together, and there would be Sterling Bose, and Bob Chester on tenor, and Charlie Spivak on trumpet.

ctx.x: You had a circle of musicians who were all . . . all became bandleaders in their own right later on.
A lot of them did. Charlie Spivak came from New Haven. He became a bandleader.
